context:
Goal: main goes green fast without breaking the red-main rule.
Problem (rule): main is red, and the merge tool refuses the fix PR #3608 because the rule lets only the revert of the blamed commit merge on a red main, so only you can allow an exception.
Based on (read): runner 10's verbatim tool text at 05:12 CST, relayed by the coordinator: "No batch merges onto a red main. Open a revert PR for the breaking merge named above ... and merge it with the reason flag --base-red-ok "<reason>". ... Or, if this batch carries the fix, or the unknown read has a known cause, run again with the reason flag --base-red-ok "<reason>"." Triage read on REST at 04:13 CST: main's run 44052915578 on 71f78cc38676 (#3469's merge) ended failure at attempt 2.
Based on (notes): the coordinator's relay: run 44052915578 failed twice on job checks-waiting-page; #3608 is a test-file-only fix, its run is green, it is clean at head 43a2dbcef591 (REST, coordinator 05:10 CST, not read by triage); the consultant said at 03:54 CST that #3469 touches neither page.html nor page.test.mjs (the coordinator did not verify it) and at 04:14 CST that the case passed 10 of 10.
Departs from: main — CLAUDE.md git-red-main-reverts lets only the revert of the blamed commit merge on a red main — a lets one fix PR, #3608, merge on red main with one use of the flag; b opens an exact revert of #3469 and merges it with the flag; c waits for a green re-run of main.
Meanwhile: the coordinator holds #3608, #3577 and #3569, and every later merge waits behind the red main.
Waiting on: you.
holds: Main is red, and #3608, #3577, #3569 and every later merge wait.
